home.title: ArGeles — Artisan jellies, made to order
home.description: Hand-moulded jellies decorated with fresh fruit, made for the date of your celebration. Choose your piece and order it on WhatsApp.

links.title: ArGeles — Links
links.description: Message us on WhatsApp, visit the website or download the PDF price list.

hero.headline: Delicacy in every layer
hero.body: Hand-moulded and finished with fresh fruit. Each piece is made for the date of your celebration: weddings, christenings, birthdays and dessert tables.

notes.notice: Orders are taken at least three days ahead.
notes.fruit: Every jelly is made to order, with selected fresh fruit.
notes.flavours: The flavours and the fruit of every piece can be adapted to your taste.
notes.deposit: A 50% deposit reserves your order and is not refundable if the order is cancelled; the rest is paid on the day of delivery.
notes.receipt: Once the deposit is paid, send us the payment receipt.
notes.delivery: Large jellies are delivered in their box; individual portions with a lid and a spoon.
notes.currency: Prices in US dollars. Payments in bolívares follow the day's BCV rate.

section.title: Catalogue
section.subtitle: Every piece is made to order with selected fresh fruit. Choose yours and order it on WhatsApp.

hints.pickAny: Pick as many as you like

encapsulated-fruit.name: Encapsulated Fruit
encapsulated-fruit.note: Fresh fruit in clear jelly over tres leches
encapsulated-fruit.description: Fresh fruit of your choice suspended in a layer of clear jelly, over a base of tres leches jelly.
encapsulated-fruit.imageAlt: Clear jelly crown with strawberries, purple grapes, peach and green grapes

neapolitan-fruit.name: Neapolitan Fruit
neapolitan-fruit.note: Sliced fruit over fruit stripes and tres leches
neapolitan-fruit.description: Sliced fresh fruit over fine stripes of fruit-flavoured jelly of your choice and tres leches jelly.
neapolitan-fruit.imageAlt: Rectangular jelly with red, white and green layers, sliced strawberries on top

tres-leches-crown.name: Tres Leches Crown
tres-leches-crown.note: Fruit flavour and tres leches in a ring mould
tres-leches-crown.description: Fruit-flavoured jelly of your choice and tres leches jelly alternating in a ring mould.
tres-leches-crown.imageAlt: Flower-mould jelly, red on top and cream below, on a gold board

crowned-two-tone.name: Crowned Two-Tone
crowned-two-tone.note: Two tones of fruit, crowned with fresh fruit
crowned-two-tone.description: Fruit-flavoured jelly of your choice in two tones, one intense and one with condensed milk, crowned with fresh fruit.
crowned-two-tone.imageAlt: Fluted jelly mould, dark purple over a lilac layer, with grapes at the centre

fresh-fruit-mosaic.name: Fresh Fruit Mosaic
fresh-fruit-mosaic.note: Fruit cubes over stripes with condensed milk
fresh-fruit-mosaic.description: Fresh fruit cubes in the top layer and stripes of fruit-flavoured jelly with condensed milk.
fresh-fruit-mosaic.imageAlt: Round scalloped pink jelly with strawberry cubes in its clear top layer

crystal-and-cream.name: Crystal and Cream
crystal-and-cream.note: One clear layer and one creamy base
crystal-and-cream.description: Fruit-flavoured jelly of your choice in two layers, one clear and a creamy base with condensed milk.
crystal-and-cream.imageAlt: Red jelly in a round pearl mould on a white plate

individual-portion.name: Individual Portion
individual-portion.note: With a lid and a spoon, ready to serve
individual-portion.description: A creamy fruit-flavoured jelly base, fresh fruit cubes and a jelly flower. Ready to serve, with its lid and spoon.
individual-portion.imageAlt: Lidded individual cups of strawberry jelly with fruit cubes and a pink flower on top
